headline: Continued 103 Clark Lane ANR plan to give the applicant time to answer surveyor and engineering questions.
summary: The plan combines two lots at 103 Clark Lane so a house can be rebuilt there. Questions from the reviewing surveyor remained unanswered, including one about Sanders Lane. The applicant asked for more time, so the item moves to the next meeting.
decisions: Continued the ANR plan for 103 Clark Lane to the next meeting on December 2 at 6 o'clock.
discussion: Sanders Lane right-of-way: Speakers discussed whether Sanders Lane is a public street, citing a 1951 plan that shows it approved as a street while the survey plan calls it private and narrower.
Surveyor review comments: Members said an engineer's email approving the plan did not answer the surveyor reviewer's comments, which need written responses.
FEMA flood zone: The property was described as zone X, outside the hundred-year floodplain.
Street name spelling: Members asked that Sanders Lane and Sanderson Lane be corrected to one spelling before the plan is final.

decision_evidence.quote: We'll make that as a motion. Is there a second on that? Second. Okay any discussion? All those in favor? Aye. All those opposed? Thank you.

problems.what: continued, but the decision or the minutes don't say so
